correctness.rationale: In PG(2,3) there are 13 rational points and 13 lines, each four points. A smooth F3-conic is a four-arc, and each four-arc has a unique smooth conic because three of the four conic equations through a projective frame are reducible. Independently enumerated the 234 four-arcs and separately all 234 geometrically smooth scalar-normalized quadratic forms by Hessian determinant. For all C(234,2)=27261 distinct unordered conic pairs independently counted 11466 blocking unions, 1638 nontrivially blocking (no full rational line), split 702 six-point and 936 seven-point pairs. Their distinct union masks total 234 at each size, complement maps 6-sets to 7-sets, decomposition multiplicities exactly 3 and 4. Generated all PGL3(F3) permutations (5616), computed precisely five pair orbits with sizes 702,936,5616,1404,2808 and the claimed incidence spectra; checked 6-point inclusion-minimality via missing-line test in source. Finite exhaustive proof is valid for precisely q=3; no extrapolation to all q.
